note: SRA on Hugh Butler Lake (Red Willow Reservoir, 1,628 acres), ~10 mi N of McCook. Willow View Campground runs along a ridge above the lake's east arm, with gravel pads and a panoramic view of the lake. Basic sites at North Lookout, South Lookout and the Red Willow Area. Swimming beach, ADA fishing dock, fish-cleaning station, archery range. No golf carts or 4-wheelers. --Claude
